BREAKING: The Philippines has approved Starlink Direct-to-Cell service. 🇵🇭

Globe has received official authorization to launch the service, making the Philippines the first country in Southeast Asia where standard LTE phones can connect directly to satellites.

No extra hardware or special app is required. Users only need a compatible phone, an active Globe SIM and a clear view of the sky.

This is a major step for connecting remote islands, mountain communities, maritime areas and disaster-hit regions where traditional cell towers cannot reach.

BREAKING: Starlink is now New Zealand's largest rural internet provider. 🇳🇿

Starlink has grown to 27% of the country's rural broadband market, up from 19% just one year ago.

Satellite broadband connections climbed 52% from 56,000 to 85,000, with around 72,000 serving rural homes.

Starlink Residential delivers average download speeds of 226 Mbps, about 4x faster than rural 4G fixed wireless at 56 Mbps.

For thousands of families, farms and remote communities, Starlink is closing the connectivity gap.
